# Vendored model

`allosaurus-uni2005.tar.gz` is the Allosaurus universal phone model `uni2005`
(Li et al. 2020, "Universal Phone Recognition with a Multilingual Allophone System"),
originally published at https://github.com/xinjli/allosaurus/releases/download/v1.0/uni2005.tar.gz
under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (the licence of the Allosaurus project).
It is kept here unchanged because the original download link was returning HTTP 504.
SHA-256 of the archive: see `allosaurus-uni2005.tar.gz.sha256`.
